title: Documentation: module-level docs, doc-tests, security note, README stub
description:
Public API documentation for yencoding-multi.

Depends on: MIME-j5n.4 (API stable)

What to do:
- lib.rs: top-of-file module doc explaining what yencoding-multi does, which problem it solves (multi-part yEnc reassembly), and a minimal end-to-end example in a doc-test showing Assembler::new + add_part + finish
- assembler.rs: doc comment on Assembler struct, on each method (new, add_part, is_complete, missing_ranges, finish)
- error.rs: doc comment on AssemblyError and each variant explaining when it fires
- Security note in lib.rs: CRC32 is a data integrity check, not a cryptographic hash; do not use for security purposes
- README.md at crate root: crate purpose, quick example, MSRV badge placeholder, license
- Acceptance: RUSTDOCFLAGS='--cfg docsrs -D warnings' cargo +nightly doc --no-deps -p yencoding-multi produces no warnings; doc-tests pass
close_reason: lib.rs module docs, security note, quick-start no_run example. README.md. All public items documented.
